user.title: Home Maintenance Manager
user.description: Name your property and individually select maintenance tasks to track.

init.title: Home Maintenance Manager
init.description: Manage maintenance tasks, add custom tasks, or register household equipment.

configure_notifications.title: Maintenance notifications
configure_notifications.description: Enable individual reminders and a daily summary. Select an available Home Assistant mobile app notify service to send mobile notifications. If no mobile app services are available, you can enter a service name manually. Leave it blank to use Home Assistant persistent notifications.

data.notification_lead_days: Remind this many days before a task is due

manage_tasks.title: Maintenance task selection
manage_tasks.description: Select the built-in and custom tasks to track. Configure intervals in the next step.

intervals.title: Maintenance intervals
intervals.description: Set the interval in days for each selected recurring task. Seasonal tasks use their season windows instead.

add_custom_task.title: Add a custom maintenance task
add_custom_task.description: Create a custom task using an interval, annual calendar date, or monthly weekday pattern. You can also add inspection steps, warning signs, actions, and safety notes.

data.name: Task name
data.how_to_inspect: How to inspect (one step per line)
data.what_to_look_for: What to look for (one item per line)
data.what_to_do_if_issue: What to do if something is wrong

add_equipment.title: Register household equipment
add_equipment.description: Add an appliance or home system and optionally associate existing maintenance tasks with it. You can leave manufacturer, model, installation date, and notes blank. To schedule automatic replacement, provide an installation date, expected lifespan, and a designated replacement task. The replacement task is added to the equipment's associated tasks.

data.name: Equipment name
data.task_ids: Maintenance tasks associated with this equipment
data.replacement_task_id: Task to make due when replacement is needed

manage_equipment.title: Select household equipment
manage_equipment.description: Choose the equipment record you want to edit or remove.

equipment_actions.title: Equipment actions
equipment_actions.description: Edit the selected equipment record or remove it.

menu_options.edit_equipment: Edit equipment details and task links

edit_equipment.title: Edit household equipment
edit_equipment.description: Update the equipment details and associated maintenance tasks. To schedule automatic replacement, provide an installation date, expected lifespan, and a designated replacement task. The replacement task is added to the equipment's associated tasks.

data.name: Equipment name
data.task_ids: Maintenance tasks associated with this equipment
data.replacement_task_id: Task to make due when replacement is needed

remove_equipment.title: Remove household equipment
remove_equipment.description: Confirm removal of {equipment_name}. Existing maintenance history is retained.

data.confirm: I confirm that I want to remove this equipment record

manage_custom_tasks.title: Select a custom maintenance task
manage_custom_tasks.description: Choose the custom task you want to edit or remove.

custom_task_actions.title: Custom task actions
custom_task_actions.description: Edit task details and its recurring schedule, or remove this custom task.

edit_custom_task.title: Edit custom maintenance task
edit_custom_task.description: Update task details and schedule. Annual tasks repeat on a selected month and day; monthly tasks repeat on a selected weekday pattern. Existing completion history is retained.

data.name: Task name
data.how_to_inspect: How to inspect (one step per line)
data.what_to_look_for: What to look for (one item per line)
data.what_to_do_if_issue: What to do if something is wrong

remove_custom_task.title: Remove custom maintenance task
remove_custom_task.description: Confirm removal of {task_name}. Its completion history will be retained.

data.confirm: I confirm that I want to remove this custom task

configure_season_windows.title: Seasonal scheduling windows
configure_season_windows.description: Set the start and end dates for each season. Enter dates in MM-DD format. Winter can span the end of the year.

error.duplicate_task: A task with this name already exists. Choose a different name.
error.invalid_annual_date: Enter a valid calendar date. February 29 is allowed.
error.duplicate_equipment: Equipment with this name already exists. Choose a different name.
error.invalid_date: Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD, or leave the field blank.
error.incomplete_lifespan: For automatic replacement scheduling, enter an installation date, lifespan, and replacement task together, or leave all three unset.
error.duplicate_replacement_task: Each equipment record must have its own designated replacement task.

abort.no_equipment: No equipment records have been added yet.
abort.equipment_not_found: The selected equipment record could not be found.
abort.no_custom_tasks: No custom maintenance tasks have been created yet.
abort.custom_task_not_found: The selected custom maintenance task could not be found.
